strings.zh: 这里是白银山脉。
strings.en: Mt. Silver
strings.notes: US 0636/0 Bank is mixed: #1–#70 Three Island lifeguard/Charmander revenge quest (Alto Mare Islands); #71 sign; #72–#117 Manaphy Egg; #118–#138 island trainers/NPCs; #139–#168 Mt. Silver foot before the Silver Conference.

strings.zh: 救生员呆呆地望着岸上的九尾,{NEWLINE}眼神中既有欣慰又有落寞。
strings.en: The lifeguard gazes blankly at the{NEWLINE}Vulpix on the shore, his eyes full of{CLEAR}both relief and loneliness.
strings.notes: D-0745 (D-1496/D-1572, approved by the user 2026-10-06): zh 九尾 (Ninetales) corrected to Vulpix, the only fox in the scene (#2-#5); same text as 0393#1.

strings.zh: 啊……你好。{NEWLINE}刚刚我的注意力都在六尾身上,{CLEAR}没有注意到面前还站着人。{CLEAR}我是这一带的救生员,{CLEAR}这只六尾是我和乘龙冒着生命危险{CLEAR}从海潮中救下来的。{CLEAR}看到它现在活蹦乱跳的样子,{CLEAR}我就觉得我的付出都是值得的。
strings.en: Ah... Hello. I was so focused on Vulpix,{NEWLINE}I didn’t notice someone standing right{CLEAR}in front of me.{SCROLL}I’m the lifeguard around here.{SCROLL}My Lapras and I risked our lives to{NEWLINE}rescue this Vulpix from the tide.{SCROLL}Seeing it bouncing around so happily{NEWLINE}now, I know it was all worth it.

strings.zh: 六尾『Vuuuu——pi！
strings.en: Vulpix: Vuuuu-pi!

strings.zh: 乘龙『Laaa——pra！
strings.en: Lapras: Laaa-pra!

strings.zh: 六尾『Vuuuu——pi！{NEWLINE}乘龙『Laaa——pra！{SCROLL}两只精灵互相蹭了蹭对方。
strings.en: Vulpix: Vuuuu-pi!{NEWLINE}Lapras: Laaa-pra!{SCROLL}The two Pokémon nuzzle each other.

strings.zh: 嘿嘿,这两只精灵感情还不错吧？
strings.en: Heh heh, these two get along pretty{NEWLINE}well, don’t they?

strings.zh: 看到小火龙的主人能够看开,{NEWLINE}我心中的一块石头也算是落地了。
strings.en: Seeing Charmander’s owner come to{NEWLINE}terms with it has taken a weight off{CLEAR}my mind.

strings.zh: 小火龙的死与你有关？
strings.en: Did Charmander die because of you?

strings.zh: 真是两只可爱的精灵
strings.en: What cute Pokémon!

strings.zh: {VAR:0103:0}『嗯,两只精灵都很可爱呢。
strings.en: {VAR:0103:0}: Yes, they’re both really cute.

strings.zh: {VAR:0103:0}『我看你是一位{NEWLINE}非常有爱心的救生员,{CLEAR}可是有人说你害死了他的小火龙,{CLEAR}这到底是怎么回事？
strings.en: {VAR:0103:0}: You seem like a lifeguard who{NEWLINE}really cares.{SCROLL}But someone says you got his{NEWLINE}Charmander killed. What happened?

strings.zh: 啊……这……,{NEWLINE}也可以说是确有其事吧。{CLEAR}有一次大涨潮时,{CLEAR}海岸边正好有一只家养小火龙{CLEAR}和一只野生六尾在玩耍,{CLEAR}这时候一个大浪过来,{CLEAR}两只精灵都被卷进了海里。{CLEAR}当时我和小火龙的主人都在附近,{CLEAR}小火龙的主人不会游唦,{CLEAR}就拜托我去救小火龙。{CLEAR}但我的位置离六尾比较近,{CLEAR}于是我和乘龙就先把六尾救上了岸。{CLEAR}等我们回头再去救小火龙的时候,{CLEAR}小火龙的生命之火{CLEAR}已经被海水彻底扑灭了……{SCROLL}那天小火龙的主人{NEWLINE}抱着小火龙冰冷的身体{CLEAR}失声痛哭的样子,{CLEAR}在我脑海中萦绕至今……
strings.en: Ah... That... Well, I suppose you could{NEWLINE}say it’s true.{SCROLL}Once, during a big high tide, a pet{NEWLINE}Charmander and a wild Vulpix were{CLEAR}playing by the shore.{SCROLL}Then a huge wave came in and swept both{NEWLINE}Pokémon out to sea.{SCROLL}Charmander’s owner and I were both{NEWLINE}nearby.{SCROLL}He couldn’t swim, so he begged me to{NEWLINE}save his Charmander.{SCROLL}But I was closer to Vulpix, so Lapras{NEWLINE}and I got Vulpix to shore first.{SCROLL}By the time we went back for{NEWLINE}Charmander...{SCROLL}The seawater had already put out the{NEWLINE}flame of its life for good...{SCROLL}That day, Charmander’s owner held its{NEWLINE}cold body and sobbed his heart out.{SCROLL}I still can’t get that sight out of my{NEWLINE}head...
strings.notes: Branch: #8/#9 and #13/#14 are menu choices at the lifeguard; revenge route #38–#48 (fight the lifeguard for the owner) vs. mediation route #15–#37/#49–#58/#68–#70.

strings.zh: 用你的乘龙给小火龙偿命
strings.en: Lapras’s life for Charmander’s
strings.notes: tone review: 偿命 = a life for a life (D-0627)

strings.zh: 看来这件事也不能怪你
strings.en: Then it wasn’t your fault

strings.zh: {VAR:0103:0}『原来是一场意外。{NEWLINE}我觉得你已经尽到了救生员的职责,{CLEAR}小火龙的死错不在你,{CLEAR}你不必太过自责。
strings.en: {VAR:0103:0}: So it was an accident.{SCROLL}I think you did everything a lifeguard{NEWLINE}should. Charmander’s death wasn’t{CLEAR}your fault.{SCROLL}You don’t need to blame yourself so{NEWLINE}much.

strings.zh: 谢谢你……
strings.en: Thank you...

strings.zh: 看你那副软弱的样子,{NEWLINE}我就知道报仇的事不能指望你。{CLEAR}还是我亲自来吧！
strings.en: Look at you, so spineless. I knew I{NEWLINE}couldn’t count on you for my revenge.{SCROLL}I’ll do it myself!

strings.zh: 你挡在我面前算怎么回事,{NEWLINE}是想阻止我报仇吗？
strings.en: What do you think you’re doing,{NEWLINE}standing in my way? Are you trying to{CLEAR}stop my revenge?

strings.zh: {VAR:0103:0}『小火龙的事{NEWLINE}确实非常让人伤心,{CLEAR}但请你冷静地想一想,{CLEAR}那其实是一场意外,{CLEAR}你不该迁怒救生员和他的乘龙。
strings.en: {VAR:0103:0}: What happened to Charmander{NEWLINE}is truly heartbreaking.{SCROLL}But please, think about it calmly. It{NEWLINE}was an accident.{SCROLL}You shouldn’t take it out on the{NEWLINE}lifeguard and his Lapras.

strings.zh: 小火龙落水确实是意外,{NEWLINE}但如果他放弃六尾{CLEAR}先去救我的小火龙,{CLEAR}小火龙一定能活下来！{CLEAR}我无法接受这样的结果,{CLEAR}我要他的乘龙以命抵命！
strings.en: Charmander falling into the sea was an{NEWLINE}accident, sure.{SCROLL}But if he’d left Vulpix and saved my{NEWLINE}Charmander first, it would definitely{CLEAR}still be alive!{SCROLL}I can’t accept that! I want his Lapras{NEWLINE}to pay with its life!

strings.zh: {VAR:0103:0}『从尊重生命的角度讲,{NEWLINE}大家的生命都是平等的,{CLEAR}没有谁比谁高贵。{CLEAR}救生员优先救更容易施救的精灵,{CLEAR}并没有什么问题。{CLEAR}请你控制一下情绪……
strings.en: {VAR:0103:0}: If we respect life, then every{NEWLINE}life is equal. No one is worth more than{CLEAR}anyone else.{SCROLL}There’s nothing wrong with a lifeguard{NEWLINE}saving the Pokémon that’s easier to{CLEAR}rescue first.{SCROLL}Please try to control your feelings...

strings.zh: 够了！你不要再说了……！
strings.en: Enough! Don’t say another word...!

strings.zh: ……{SCROLL}呜……{SCROLL}呜呜呜……你说的道理我都懂,{NEWLINE}但是如果他先救小火龙的话……{CLEAR}呜呜呜……
strings.en: ...{SCROLL}*sob*...{SCROLL}*sob sob*... I get everything you’re{NEWLINE}saying...{SCROLL}But if he’d saved Charmander first...{NEWLINE}*sob sob*...

strings.zh: 六尾『Vuuuu——pi……{SCROLL}六尾蹭了蹭中年男子。
strings.en: Vulpix: Vuuuu-pi...{SCROLL}Vulpix nuzzles the middle-aged man.

strings.zh: 六尾……小火龙的死你也有份！！！
strings.en: Vulpix... You’re to blame for{NEWLINE}Charmander’s death too!!!

strings.zh: 六尾『Vuuuu——Vuuuu——！{SCROLL}六尾泪眼汪汪地看着中年年子。
strings.en: Vulpix: Vuuuu-Vuuuu-!{SCROLL}Vulpix gazes at the middle-aged man with{NEWLINE}teary eyes.
strings.notes: zh typo 中年年子 read as 中年男子 (middle-aged man).

strings.zh: 小火龙,你是小火龙！？
strings.en: Charmander... Is that you,{NEWLINE}Charmander?!

strings.zh: 不、不,你是六尾,不是小火龙。{NEWLINE}是我眼花了……
strings.en: N-no... You’re a Vulpix, not{NEWLINE}Charmander. My eyes are playing tricks{CLEAR}on me...

strings.zh: 对不起,请听我说一句。{NEWLINE}那天没能赶得及救下小火龙{CLEAR}我也非常自责。{CLEAR}如果给您带来了悲伤的情绪,{CLEAR}就请冲我发泄吧。{CLEAR}您和精灵都是无辜的,{CLEAR}请放过它们和您自己吧。
strings.en: I’m sorry. Please, hear me out.{SCROLL}I blame myself too for not getting to{NEWLINE}Charmander in time that day.{SCROLL}If I’ve caused you this grief, then{NEWLINE}please take it out on me.{SCROLL}You and the Pokémon are innocent.{NEWLINE}Please spare them, and spare yourself.
Ah... *sigh*...

strings.zh: 你们说的道理我都懂,我都懂……{SCROLL}如果上天非要安排六尾{NEWLINE}代替小火龙活在这个世界上,{CLEAR}也就只能这样了……
strings.en: I get what you’re all saying. I do...{SCROLL}If heaven insists that Vulpix live on in{NEWLINE}this world in Charmander’s place...{SCROLL}Then so be it...

strings.zh: 这只六尾还没有被人收服,{NEWLINE}如果您不嫌弃的话,{CLEAR}就请收服它……
strings.en: Nobody has caught this Vulpix yet.{SCROLL}If you don’t mind, please take it as{NEWLINE}your own...

strings.zh: 不必了,这么活泼可爱的精灵,{NEWLINE}不太适合现在的我。{CLEAR}你就好好照顾它吧,{CLEAR}让它代替小火龙好好活下去。
strings.en: No need. A lively, lovable Pokémon like{NEWLINE}that isn’t right for me as I am now.{SCROLL}You take good care of it. Let it live a{NEWLINE}good life in Charmander’s place.

strings.zh: 没问题,交给我吧！
strings.en: No problem. Leave it to me!

strings.zh: 你是个出色的救生员,{NEWLINE}继续在这个岗位上加油吧……
strings.en: You’re a fine lifeguard. Keep up the{NEWLINE}good work at your post...

strings.zh: 啊,好！好的！
strings.en: Ah, yes! Yes, I will!

strings.zh: 也谢谢你坚持原则,{NEWLINE}阻止了我的冲动行为,{CLEAR}这个送给你,算是我的一点心意吧。
strings.en: And thank you for sticking to your{NEWLINE}principles and stopping me from doing{CLEAR}something rash.{SCROLL}Here, take this, as a small token of my{NEWLINE}thanks.

strings.zh: {VAR:0103:0}『因为你的选择,{NEWLINE}造成了小火龙丧命。{CLEAR}我今天受小火龙主人的委托,{CLEAR}来杀你的乘龙抵命！
strings.en: {VAR:0103:0}: Because of your choice,{NEWLINE}Charmander lost its life.{SCROLL}Charmander’s owner has asked me to{NEWLINE}come here today and kill your Lapras to{CLEAR}pay for it!

strings.zh: 啊！你不要伤害我的乘龙！
strings.en: Ah! Don’t hurt my Lapras!

strings.zh: 啊！你！
strings.en: Ah! You!

strings.zh: 不……这件事不怪乘龙,{NEWLINE}请你不要伤害它,{CLEAR}有什么仇什么怨冲我来吧！
strings.en: No... None of this is Lapras’s fault.{NEWLINE}Please don’t hurt it!{SCROLL}If you have a grudge, take it out on{NEWLINE}me!

strings.zh: 杀了乘龙,{NEWLINE}才是对你最好的惩罚！
strings.en: Killing your Lapras is the best{NEWLINE}punishment for you!

strings.zh: 你是那只小火龙的主人！
strings.en: You’re that Charmander’s owner!

strings.zh: 谢谢你帮我打败了这个救生员,{NEWLINE}不然以我的实力还真是拿他没办法。{CLEAR}这是给你的谢礼,{CLEAR}后面的复仇就交给我吧。
strings.en: Thanks for beating this lifeguard for{NEWLINE}me. On my own, I couldn’t have laid a{CLEAR}finger on him.{SCROLL}This is your reward. Leave the rest of{NEWLINE}the revenge to me.

strings.zh: 现在就是我的复仇时刻了,{NEWLINE}你好好体会下心爱的精灵{CLEAR}死在眼前是个什么滋味吧！
strings.en: Now it’s time for my revenge!{SCROLL}Get a good taste of what it’s like to{NEWLINE}watch your beloved Pokémon die before{CLEAR}your eyes!

strings.zh: 住手！住手啊！
strings.en: Stop! Please, stop!

strings.zh: 六尾『Vuuuu——Vuuuu——！{SCROLL}六尾向中年年子哀嚎着。
strings.en: Vulpix: Vuuuu-Vuuuu-!{SCROLL}Vulpix wails at the middle-aged man.

strings.zh: 我真的非常非常抱歉,{NEWLINE}那天没能赶得及救下小火龙{CLEAR}我也是自责无比。{CLEAR}如果给您带来了悲伤的情绪,{CLEAR}就请冲我发泄吧。{CLEAR}您和精灵都是无辜的,{CLEAR}请放过它们和您自己吧。
strings.en: I’m truly, truly sorry.{SCROLL}I blame myself terribly for not getting{NEWLINE}to Charmander in time that day.{SCROLL}If I’ve caused you this grief, then{NEWLINE}please take it out on me.{SCROLL}You and the Pokémon are innocent.{NEWLINE}Please spare them, and spare yourself.

strings.zh: 那天六尾和小火龙{NEWLINE}在岸边玩的非常开心,{CLEAR}它们两个一定成为了好朋友。{CLEAR}您的小火龙一定也不希望{CLEAR}看到您伤害六尾吧？
strings.en: That day, Vulpix and Charmander were{NEWLINE}having so much fun playing on the shore.{SCROLL}They must have become good friends.{SCROLL}Surely your Charmander wouldn’t want{NEWLINE}to see you hurt Vulpix either?

strings.zh: 小火龙……
strings.en: Charmander...

strings.zh: 六尾『Vuuuu——pi……{SCROLL}六尾舔了舔中年男子。
strings.en: Vulpix: Vuuuu-pi...{SCROLL}Vulpix licks the middle-aged man.

strings.zh: 呜呜呜……为什么,{NEWLINE}为什么你这么像小火龙……
strings.en: *sob sob*... Why... Why are you so much{NEWLINE}like Charmander...

strings.zh: 其实道理我都懂,我都懂……{NEWLINE}我就是不能接受,{CLEAR}为什么偏偏是我的小火龙……{CLEAR}为什么……
strings.en: The truth is, I get it. I do...{SCROLL}I just can’t accept it. Why did it have{NEWLINE}to be my Charmander...{SCROLL}Why...

strings.zh: 这只六尾还没有被人收服,{NEWLINE}如果您觉得它像小火龙,{CLEAR}就请用它代替……
strings.en: Nobody has caught this Vulpix yet.{SCROLL}If you feel it’s like Charmander, then{NEWLINE}please let it take{CLEAR}Charmander’s place...

strings.zh: 不必了,小火龙是小火龙,{NEWLINE}六尾是六尾,{CLEAR}毕竟还是不同的精灵。{CLEAR}况且这么活泼可爱的精灵,{CLEAR}不太适合现在的我。{CLEAR}你就好好照顾它吧,{CLEAR}让它代替小火龙好好活下去。
strings.en: No need. Charmander is Charmander, and{NEWLINE}Vulpix is Vulpix. They’re different{CLEAR}Pokémon, after all.{SCROLL}Besides, a lively, lovable Pokémon like{NEWLINE}that isn’t right for me as I am now.{SCROLL}You take good care of it. Let it live a{NEWLINE}good life in Charmander’s place.

strings.zh: 唉……没错,{NEWLINE}这些可爱的精灵也都是生命,{CLEAR}尤其是六尾这舔人的感觉{CLEAR}跟小火龙那么像……
strings.en: *sigh*... You’re right. These cute{NEWLINE}Pokémon are living beings too.{SCROLL}And the way this Vulpix licks me... It’s{NEWLINE}so much like Charmander...

strings.zh: 我啊……就是个无能的主人,{NEWLINE}不仅没能保护好小火龙,{CLEAR}还想要伤害其他人和精灵,{CLEAR}是我太冲动了。
strings.en: Me... I’m just a useless owner.{SCROLL}Not only did I fail to protect{NEWLINE}Charmander, I even wanted to hurt{CLEAR}other people and Pokémon.{SCROLL}I was too rash.

strings.zh: 我曾经有一只小火龙,{NEWLINE}它是我最珍惜的口袋妖怪。{CLEAR}可是却被群岛的一个救生员给害死了。{CLEAR}我想要给小火龙报仇,{CLEAR}但又担心打不赢那个救生员。{CLEAR}我看你挺厉害的样子,{CLEAR}你能替我去杀了救生员的乘龙,{CLEAR}为我的小火龙报仇吗？
strings.en: I once had a Charmander. It was my{NEWLINE}most treasured Pokémon.{SCROLL}But a lifeguard on the islands got it{NEWLINE}killed.{SCROLL}I want to avenge Charmander, but I’m{NEWLINE}afraid I can’t beat that lifeguard.{SCROLL}You look pretty strong.{SCROLL}Could you go kill that lifeguard’s{NEWLINE}Lapras for me and avenge{CLEAR}my Charmander?

strings.zh: 我来主持公道
strings.en: I’ll see justice done

strings.zh: 不关我事
strings.en: Not my problem

strings.zh: {VAR:0103:0}『如果真是有人{NEWLINE}害死了你的精灵,{CLEAR}我会为你主持公道的。
strings.en: {VAR:0103:0}: If someone really got your{NEWLINE}Pokémon killed, I’ll see that justice{CLEAR}is done.

strings.zh: 谢谢你愿意帮忙。{NEWLINE}那个救生员就在三之岛东侧的海域,{CLEAR}他最亲密的精灵是一只乘龙,{CLEAR}你帮我解决那只乘龙就好了。
strings.en: Thank you for agreeing to help.{SCROLL}That lifeguard is in the waters east of{NEWLINE}Three Island.{SCROLL}The Pokémon closest to him is a Lapras.{NEWLINE}Just take care of that Lapras for me.

strings.zh: {VAR:0103:0}『这……我会去看看的。
strings.en: {VAR:0103:0}: Well... I’ll go take a look.

strings.zh: 那个救生员就在三之岛东侧的海域,{NEWLINE}他最亲密的精灵是一只乘龙,{CLEAR}你帮我解决那只乘龙就好了。
strings.en: That lifeguard is in the waters east of{NEWLINE}Three Island.{SCROLL}The Pokémon closest to him is a Lapras.{NEWLINE}Just take care of that Lapras for me.

strings.zh: 唉……往事历历在目,却已物是人非。
strings.en: *sigh*... The past is still so vivid, yet{NEWLINE}nothing is the same anymore.

strings.zh: 对不起小火龙,{NEWLINE}我的能力就到此为止了,{CLEAR}没有办法为你报仇了……
strings.en: I’m sorry, Charmander. This is as far as{NEWLINE}my strength goes.{SCROLL}I can’t avenge you...

strings.zh: {VAR:0103:0}『够了,你冷静冷静吧！{NEWLINE}你失去伙伴的悲痛我们都能理解,{CLEAR}但伤心的并不只是你,{CLEAR}救生员看到你那痛苦的样子,{CLEAR}他也非常难过。{CLEAR}你们都是热爱精灵的人,{CLEAR}请不要再有伤害别人的想法了。
strings.en: {VAR:0103:0}: Enough! Calm down!{SCROLL}We all understand the pain of losing a{NEWLINE}partner. But you’re not the only{CLEAR}one hurting.{SCROLL}Seeing you suffer like this hurts the{NEWLINE}lifeguard too.{SCROLL}You both love Pokémon. Please, stop{NEWLINE}thinking about hurting others.

strings.zh: 如果上天非要安排六尾{NEWLINE}代替小火龙活在这个世界上,{CLEAR}也就只能这样了……
strings.en: If heaven insists that Vulpix live on in{NEWLINE}this world in Charmander’s place...{SCROLL}Then so be it...

strings.zh: 六尾,你是在安慰我吗？
strings.en: Vulpix, are you trying to comfort me?

strings.zh: 由此向北——五之岛,{NEWLINE}由此向西——四之岛。
strings.en: North: Five Island{NEWLINE}West: Four Island

strings.zh: 嘿嘿,是你呀。{NEWLINE}我按照你的建议,{CLEAR}围着水都群岛走了好大一圈。{CLEAR}最近我感觉这颗蛋一动一动的,{CLEAR}是不是快要孵化了啊？
strings.en: Hee hee, it’s you.{SCROLL}I took your advice and walked a big loop{NEWLINE}all around the Alto Mare Islands.{SCROLL}Lately I can feel this Egg wiggling. Does{NEWLINE}that mean it’s about to hatch?

strings.zh: {VAR:0103:0}『哦？蛋自己会动了？{NEWLINE}那岂不是就要孵化了？
strings.en: {VAR:0103:0}: Oh? The Egg is moving on its{NEWLINE}own? Then it must be about to hatch!

strings.zh: 你看,刚刚这颗蛋是不是又动了？
strings.en: Look! Didn’t the Egg just move again?

strings.zh: {VAR:0103:0}『没错,确实是动了！
strings.en: {VAR:0103:0}: Yes, it definitely moved!

strings.zh: 玛纳菲『Maaa——na！
strings.en: Manaphy: Maaa-na!

strings.zh: 孵化了孵化了！孵化出口袋妖怪了！
strings.en: It hatched! It hatched! A Pokémon{NEWLINE}hatched!

strings.zh: {VAR:0103:0}『这只精灵是……？{NEWLINE}我好想没怎么见过啊。
strings.en: {VAR:0103:0}: What Pokémon is this...? I{NEWLINE}don’t think I’ve ever seen one.

strings.zh: 哎呀一看你就不怎么看童话书,{NEWLINE}这只精灵是玛纳菲啦,{CLEAR}属于传说中的口袋妖怪,{CLEAR}童话书上说玛纳菲会指引训练家{CLEAR}找到大海中的宝藏哦。

strings.zh: 原来你是冠军大人呀,{NEWLINE}难怪你这么厉害！{CLEAR}当年我听说你在华蓝洞穴{CLEAR}打败了坂木的时候,{CLEAR}我兴奋了好久呢！
